subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Should an omitted sandbox backend continue to mean Docker, or may OpenClaw automatically cross to Podman when Docker is unavailable?
rationale: This choice changes the implicit runtime and isolation boundary for existing configurations; tests can verify either implementation, but they cannot establish the intended compatibility and security policy.

options.title: Preserve Docker default
options.body: Keep Podman as an explicit backend and retain the current actionable Docker failure when `backend` is omitted.

options.title: Approve automatic fallback
options.body: Adopt Docker-then-Podman selection as a deliberate compatibility contract, with explicit upgrade documentation and proof covering both engines and Docker-unavailable states.

recommendation.title: Preserve Docker default
recommendation.body: Keep Podman as an explicit backend and retain the current actionable Docker failure when `backend` is omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head and fallback architecture were introduced in sallyom's shared container-backend refactor.
